title: Presidential candidates ramp up campaign schedule in Rio
subtitle: Electoral campaign highlights commitments in the Fluminense capital
excerpt: Presidential candidates' schedules highlighted commitments in Rio de Janeiro, with simultaneous rallies in the state capital.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The schedules of candidates for President of the Republic were primarily defined by the campaign commitments of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro in Rio de Janeiro.

Both candidates participated in rallies in the Fluminense capital, held simultaneously, marking the momentum of the race for the highest office in the federal executive branch.

Rallies in the Fluminense capital

Campaign activities in Rio de Janeiro concentrated a significant portion of the public schedules announced for the presidential race, attracting the attention of voters and supporters in the state capital.

With information from Agência Brasil.
